caption:
You feel like you don't belong at the table. But what if your seat was never something you had to earn? (Galatians 2:14-16 devotional)

When Peter drew back, he stopped walking in step with the gospel — because at God's table it's never your résumé that seats you, only Christ's welcome. You aren't justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus, so your place was bought, not earned. And what He paid for cannot be revoked.
